summary: Da Nang’s night is a few streets inland from My Khe. Ho Chi Minh City is the late city. Da Lat’s evening is the lake, not a beach-bar strip.
body: An Thuong sits just inland from My Khe, bounded by Vo Nguyen Giap, Hoang Ke Viem, Chau Thi Vinh Te, and Ngo Thi Si. On the sand, Kalà Kalà at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap is free to enter. Its own site lists both midnight and 02:00 as closing, so the hour is check on arrival. East West’s beachfront taproom pours from 08:00 to 01:00. The street number is not on that page.

In Ho Chi Minh City, book a street set back from the night clubs if you want sleep. Da Lat after dark is the night market, rice paper on the grill and hot soy milk, with the path around Xuan Huong still lit. Vung Tau’s walk is Front Beach, on the southwest arc between Big Mountain and Small Mountain. A night on the Cham Islands is a village house in Bai Lang after the day boats go back to Cửa Đại.
